hero.kicker: Commercial snow removal in Flint Township, MI
hero.title: Lots and entrances, **cleared and salted.**
hero.lede: Grand Scapes plows and salts parking lots, drives and walks for Flint Township businesses, offices, apartment communities and associations, and keeps the grounds mowed and the beds clean in summer.

local.title: Retail, office and **apartment lots.**
local.intro: Flint Township holds a big share of the area's shopping and services. Its economic development plan points to retail along the Miller, Linden and Corunna Road corridors, offices along Beecher Road and commercial and industrial uses along Bristol Road. Apartment buildings and medical offices add more lots, drives and walks to clear.

points.title: County and state roads out front
points.body: Roads here belong to the Genesee County Road Commission, or to MDOT for state roads, and both clear main routes first. Their plows can leave a ridge across an entrance after the lot is done, so entrances get planned for.

points.title: Piles kept clear of the exit
points.body: Michigan law bars piling snow on a roadway or its shoulder in a way that blocks a driver's view. On a corner lot or a busy entrance, where the piles go is a safety call, so it gets worked out before the first storm.

points.title: Apartments and associations
points.body: Apartment buildings and associations need their drives, lots and walks open for residents heading out early for work, including the walks from each building to the parking.

points.title: Grounds in summer
points.body: The same account can cover weekly mowing, edging, beds and cleanups, so a manager has one call for the property all year. Our clippings and debris leave with us, since the township hauler does not take contractor material.

logistics.title: How a commercial account works in Flint Township.
body: Before winter, Rob tours the property with you or your manager, marks the entrances, drive lanes, walks, ramps and the places snow can be stacked, and explains the commercial snow and salting package options.

In a storm our trucks plow the lot and the drive lanes, the walks and entrances get cleared, and ice melt goes where people walk and cars stop. Salt damages plants through spray and soil buildup, MSU Extension notes, so piles stay off the landscaped islands where the lot allows.
From spring to fall the grounds get mowed, trimmed, edged and blown off weekly, with beds, shrubs and cleanups as the property needs. We are licensed and insured, and Rob is your contact.

facts.label: Roads out front
facts.value: County or state, not the township

faq.q: Do you do commercial snow removal in Flint Township?
faq.a: Yes. Grand Scapes plows and salts parking lots, drives and walks for businesses, offices, apartment properties and associations in Flint Township, with our own trucks. The estimate is free.

faq.q: Can you plow a retail lot on Miller Road or Linden Road?
faq.a: Yes, those corridors are part of the area we work. Each lot gets its own plan for the entrances, drive lanes and snow stacking before it is quoted.

faq.q: Where does the snow go on a commercial lot?
faq.a: On the property, never in the road. Michigan law bars depositing snow on a roadway and piling it where it blocks a driver's view at the road, so piles go to the edges or the back of the lot, away from the exits and the walks.

faq.q: Do you also mow and maintain commercial grounds in Flint Township?
faq.a: Yes. We mow, trim, edge and blow off commercial grounds weekly, keep the beds and shrubs in shape and do spring and fall cleanups. See [commercial grounds and snow](/commercial/) for how a year-round account runs.
